intervals.label: deployment
intervals.note: First specialised string January 2009; two additional strings close to the central DeepCore string were deployed in the 2010/11 austral summer.
intervals.quote: The first specialized string for DeepCore—the infill at the center of the IceCube array consisting of eight more densely deployed strings of modules—was successfully deployed in January 2009.

intervals.label: physics data taking
intervals.quote: DeepCore started acquiring physics data in April 2010, and in May 2010, it made its first observation.

name: DeepCore
notes: Sensor count for DeepCore is not published on the official pages and is left unrecorded.

placements.note: First DeepCore string deployed January 2009; two further strings in the 2010/11 season.
placements.quote: The first specialized string for DeepCore—the infill at the center of the IceCube array consisting of eight more densely deployed strings of modules—was successfully deployed in January 2009.

depth_max.note: See depth_min: inherited from the parent array, not a DeepCore-specific published value.
depth_max.quote: The DOMs are attached to vertical “strings,” frozen into 86 boreholes and arrayed over a cubic kilometer from 1,450 meters to 2,450 meters depth.

depth_min.note: The official pages do not give a separate depth range for DeepCore; the parent array range is recorded and should be replaced with the DeepCore-specific range (deep, below the dust layer) when a source is available.
depth_min.quote: The DOMs are attached to vertical “strings,” frozen into 86 boreholes and arrayed over a cubic kilometer from 1,450 meters to 2,450 meters depth.

energy_range.quote: This denser configuration forms the DeepCore subdetector, which lowers the neutrino energy threshold to about 10 GeV, creating the opportunity to study neutrino oscillations.
energy_range.value: Neutrino energy threshold lowered to about 10 GeV

string_count.quote: Eight of these strings at the center of the array were deployed more compactly, with a horizontal separation of about 70 meters and a vertical DOM spacing of 7 meters.

description.quote: Eight of these strings at the center of the array were deployed more compactly, with a horizontal separation of about 70 meters and a vertical DOM spacing of 7 meters.
description.value: Horizontal separation about 70 m and vertical DOM spacing 7 m, versus 125 m and 17 m in the main array

summary.plain: A tightly packed cluster of sensors in the middle of IceCube. Because the sensors sit closer together, it can see much fainter, lower-energy neutrinos, which is what makes IceCube able to study how neutrinos change type.
summary.technical: Low-energy infill subdetector: eight specially deployed strings at the centre of IceCube with ~70 m horizontal and 7 m vertical DOM spacing, lowering the neutrino energy threshold to about 10 GeV and enabling atmospheric-oscillation measurements.

technology.quote: Eight of these strings at the center of the array were deployed more compactly, with a horizontal separation of about 70 meters and a vertical DOM spacing of 7 meters.
technology.value: Densely instrumented in-ice Cherenkov infill at the centre of the IceCube array
